title_en: Fall 2026 Research Ethics Online Training for Graduate Students
summary: Graduate students entering in Fall 2026, and enrolled students who have not completed a research ethics course or the online research ethics training, are asked to take the online Research Ethics for Graduate Students course on eTL. The course is open from Tuesday 1 September to Wednesday 30 September 2026; BK21 participating graduate students may take it until December 2026.
applies_to: Graduate students newly admitted in the second semester (Fall) of the 2026 academic year, and enrolled graduate students who have not completed a research ethics course or the online research ethics training. The notice addresses graduate students and BK21 participating graduate students and asks them to take the course actively; it does not state that the course is mandatory.

translation:
Fall 2026 Research Ethics Training for Graduate Students

To raise awareness of research ethics among members of the university, the online training "Research Ethics for Graduate Students, Fall 2026" will be held as follows. Graduate students and BK21 participating graduate students are asked to take the course actively.

A. Course title
- 2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계/이공계) [Research Ethics for Graduate Students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)]
- 2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)

B. Who should take the course
- Graduate students newly admitted in the second semester (Fall) of the 2026 academic year
- Enrolled students who have not completed a research ethics course or the online training

C. Course period: Tuesday 1 September 2026 to Wednesday 30 September 2026
※ BK21 participating graduate students may take the course until December 2026.

D. How to take the course
- Go to eTL (http://etl.snu.ac.kr) → click 'SNUON-Course List' ['SNUON-강좌목록'] on the left → search for '연구윤리 / ethics' → register for the course matching your field → take the course (takes about 2 hours)
※ Completion is recognised when you have watched 100% of all videos and viewed the learning materials. After completing the course, you can print a certificate of completion.

Attachment: Fall 2026 Research Ethics Training Course Guide for Graduate Students (Korean and English), one copy each.
Attached files (2):
- 2026 2nd-Semester Research Ethics course sign-up Guide for Graduate Students.pdf (73 KB)
- 2026학년도 2학기 대학원생 연구윤리 교육 수강 안내.pdf (87 KB)
(The contents of the attached files were not read.)
